visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: remove Takes an Index, Not a Value
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Removing the value 1 from [1, 5, 9] should leave [5, 9], but the program leaves [1, 9].

solution.explanation: On a List<Integer>, remove(1) with an int argument calls remove(int index) and deletes the element at position 1 (the 5). To remove the value 1 you must pass an Integer object: remove(Integer.valueOf(1)).
